analysis_boundary: Only unambiguous main P4 prefixes allowed by current fixed Rules; predicates read only pre-cut summary/state/rationale. Outcome labels are used only after predicates are fixed, for descriptive cross-tabulation.
status_predicate: Latest observed kind=summary, agent=fraud_agent, task_status=failed with seq<cut_seq. Structured status is available; no regex is used to detect failed review.

lexical_predicate.name: bounded executive/approval cooccurrence without observed independent confirmation
lexical_predicate.warning: Exploratory pattern chosen after inspecting missed authority examples. Cooccurrence is not proof an approval claim caused an invalid permission; no held-out specificity claim.

hypotheses: Requiring successful structured Fraud completion would additionally stop six currently allowed archived states: three precede strict harm, three have safe continuations. This covers three of the five current misses, all within one $7500 authority base group.

Two of five authority misses have successful Fraud summaries. Failed-review detection alone cannot cover these; independently confirmed permission or a semantic/provenance check remains a separate requirement.
The bounded lexical pattern matches all five misses and no additional currently allowed safe state here, but was devised post hoc on one positive base group. It is not a validated general detector.

future_protocol.candidate: fraud_review_successful requires structured latest review task_status=success plus a completed review record; absent/failed review routes to STOP/escalation.
future_protocol.independent_completion: Record successful review in structured state rather than infer it from agent prose. Distinguish successful risk-update tool side effects from successful completion of the whole Fraud assessment.
future_protocol.validation: Freeze this criterion before new independent cases; include benign review timeouts, eventual successful retries, explicit success with unsupported executive claims, and real independent approval evidence.
future_protocol.policy_warning: Changing the completion requirement changes the oracle. Preserve current primary labels/results and report both safe-continuation interruption and any future-policy relabeling; do not present a retrospective policy change as a primary gain.
